security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' blob:; worker-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Learn Rust with lessons, an editor and a real compiler
bundle.longDescription: Oxide Workbench teaches Rust step by step: ownership, borrowing, traits, iterators, concurrency and performance, ending with a key-value store and a request router. Code runs with the Rust toolchain on your computer, or with a built-in teaching interpreter when Rust is not installed.
